content: <thought>We have identified the key disconnections: (1) a retro‑SN2 breaking the C‑N bond that links the benzylic carbon to the azetidine nitrogen, (2) a retro‑amide formation (Friedel‑Crafts‑type acylation) breaking the anilide C‑N bond, and (3) a retro‑heterocycle assembly breaking the N‑substituted triazine C‑N bond. The following three‑step retrosynthetic tree uses these three transformations. The template IDs were obtained by searching the template catalog for the appropriate bond‑forming/breaking patterns.
